tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List Shipstry's product categories with the number of approved products in each. Call this first when you need a valid category slug for the other tools.

tools.name: search_launches
tools.description: Search approved Shipstry launches by keyword, category, or tag. Keyword matching covers product name and tagline. Returns compact records with votes, ship week, awards, and the canonical Shipstry URL.

tools.name: get_launch
tools.description: Fetch one approved launch with its description, tags, awards, and maker name. Identify it by Shipstry product id, product slug, its Shipstry URL, or its own website URL.

tools.name: list_ship_week
tools.description: List the products that launched in one ship week (Monday-Sunday UTC, keyed YYYYMMDD). Defaults to the current week. During Fog Mode vote counts for the current week are hidden and the order is random.

tools.name: get_winners
tools.description: Weekly or monthly medal winners (gold, silver, bronze). Returns the most recent periods by default, or one period when `period` is given. Use this to see what actually won, not just what launched.

tools.name: get_category_landscape
tools.description: Benchmark a category over a window of ship weeks: how many products launched, the vote distribution (mean, p50, p75, p90, max), the top launches, how many medals were awarded, and the tags that appear most. Use this to judge how crowded a space is and what a winning launch looks like there.

tools.name: check_url
tools.description: Check whether a website URL is already listed on Shipstry, using the same normalization as submission duplicate detection. Only approved listings are visible.
